creator: Alexander Terp
description: From tools/install-main (2026-10-21): a real install took 632 s, 380 s of it the debug build that ./dev --bundle implies (if bundle: build = true), and that build costs several GB the release bundle never uses. Measure whether anything --bundle does needs the debug build, and drop the implication if not.
title: ./dev --bundle builds the debug tree first, which a bundle never uses
